---
title: "Trap: a colour's name mistyped"
mdbrand: {brand: none, style: note}
---

pandoc keeps a span's class whatever it is, so a class one letter from a
colour's name would print its words black and the build would exit 0. It must
stop and name the colour meant.

| Partida            | Bloque           |
|:-------------------|:-----------------|
| Viajes sin aprobar | [Rojo]{.kko}     |
| Licencias anuales  | [Verde]{.OK}     |
